questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The most important aspects in my choice of study destination were the quality of education, the relevance of the program to future career goals, campus facilities and location, and cultural and social opportunities.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration process at my host institution was straightforward. First, I had to fill out an online application form and submit the necessary documents, such as proof of previous education and passport details. After receiving an acceptance, I was given access to the institution's portal where I could register for courses. Upon arrival on campus, I attended an introduction day where we received further information and help with any remaining formalities.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There were different kinds of help available. For example, IT support was available to ensure we could use the institution's online systems correctly. Help was also available to switch courses.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was very successful in registering for the classes I wanted.  I got a seat in all the courses I wanted without any problems.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Start early

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of the courses was very appropriate. There was a good balance between theoretical teaching and practical applications. The professors were competent and committed, and there were good opportunities to get extra help and guidance if needed.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The teaching was different as there was more participation from the students and a greater focus on discussion in class. There was also not a final exam, but instead several ongoing assignments that all counted towards the final assessment

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: I did not encounter any unexpected costs during my stay.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: During my exchange, I found that many groceries were more expensive than expected. On the other hand, it was often cheaper to go out and eat, both in restaurants and cafes. Public transportation was also significantly cheaper than I expected.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: My host institution offered a wide range of cultural, sporting and social activities for students. There were a lot of different clubs to join (diving club, surf club and many others)

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend future exchange students to participate in the social and cultural activities. It's a great way to integrate into the local study environment and get to know new people across cultures.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend other students to take advantage of the opportunity to explore the destination and other nearby places during weekends and vacations.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was relatively easy to adapt to the local culture. I found that people were welcoming and open to international students, which made it easier to feel welcome. There were also a lot of other exchange students

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Time differences can be a challenge at first, but it's something you get used to quickly.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I particularly appreciated the rich cultural history during my exchange. Learning about the history behind local traditions, indigenous people and historical sites was a great experience. It gave me a deeper understanding of the development of society

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Be open to new cultural norms, traditions and ways of interacting. 
2. Get involved in social and academic activities on campus. It's a great way to meet new people and make friends 
3. Take the opportunity to explore and learn more about the country and region where your host institution is located.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Try to find out about accommodation options in advance. Sometimes it can be difficult and stressful to find accommodation when you arrive.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The most rewarding part of my exchange experience was the personal growth and new perspectives I gained. Living and studying in a foreign culture broadened my horizons and strengthened my ability to adapt to different situations.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The biggest challenge during the exchange was adapting to a new culture and creating an everyday life in a foreign country

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
